name: Silvervein the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Silvervein the Elder appears on the hills above Thelsamar in Loch Modan. Travelers honor him and the ancient ties among Azeroth’s elder peoples, and he grants an ancestral blessing in return.

sections.title: A Vigil Over Thelsamar
sections.body: Above Thelsamar, Silvervein watches the ridges in silence. During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor him as a keeper of memories from ages past. Below, Loch Modan faces trogg invasions and local disputes, while the elder spirit remains peaceful on his overlook.

sections.title: Honoring the Olden Races
sections.body: Travelers who seek Silvervein find gratitude for their homage to Azeroth’s olden races. His greeting honors those who remember the ancient peoples, and he offers them a commemorative token.

faq.answer: Elder Silvervein is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival. He spends the festival atop the high bluffs near Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Silvervein?
faq.answer: Elder Silvervein is on a grassy hill overlooking Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out Elder Silvervein?
faq.answer: Travelers seek Elder Silvervein during the Lunar Festival to honor the ancestors and ancient races. He gives them a festive token and an ancestral blessing.

faq.q: What does he mean by 'the olden races'?
faq.answer: The olden races are the ancient peoples of Azeroth, who lived and shaped the world long before modern conflicts took center stage. Their heritage endures.

faq.q: Is Elder Silvervein friendly to Horde travelers?
faq.answer: Yes. Elder Silvervein welcomes peaceful travelers of every background who come during the Lunar Festival to honor the ancestors.

faq.q: Does Elder Silvervein have any connection to the trogg invasion?
faq.answer: No. Trogg incursions and excavator troubles trouble Loch Modan, but Elder Silvervein remains apart from local military conflicts and focused on honoring the ancestors.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can honor the ancient history you share with Elder Silvervein near Thelsamar.
As an Alliance traveler in Loch Modan, you can climb the ridge above Thelsamar and honor the ancient dead between trogg hunts.
